# iÚčetní

> iÚčetní is a native invoicing and tax-records app for iPhone, iPad and Mac, built for Czech sole traders and small businesses. It issues invoices with QR payments and ISDOC e-invoices, reads receipts from photos and PDFs, exports to POHODA, Money S3 and ABRA Flexi, and provides an MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT and other AI agents can work with invoices, customers and expenses. Free for one user on one device with data in the EU cloud; iÚčetní Pro (CZK 99/month or CZK 749/year, 7-day free trial) adds unlimited devices, multiple users per company, an in-app AI assistant using the user's own Claude or OpenAI API key, and on-device storage. AI usage is paid by the user to the AI provider (API usage, or their Claude/ChatGPT subscription when connecting over MCP); a limited free trial AI in the app is provided by iÚčetní. Operated by NEMOSERVIS Praha s.r.o., Czech Republic.

Key facts:
- Platforms: iOS 26, iPadOS 26, macOS 26 – one App Store app (coming soon). The app UI is in Czech.
- MCP server: `https://mcp.iucetni.com/mcp/` (Streamable HTTP). Auth: OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE S256, dynamic client registration, scope `mcp`) or a Bearer AI key issued in the app. Free in every plan.
- MCP tools include list_invoices, get_invoice, get_invoice_pdf, create_draft, update_invoice, issue_invoice, mark_invoice_paid, list_customers, create_customer, lookup_ares, list_catalog, create_catalog_item, list_expenses, create_expense, update_expense, read_receipt, list_companies, list_bank_accounts.
- Data is stored on servers in the EU. No ads, no third-party tracking.
- Czech specifics: ARES company registry lookup, Czech National Bank exchange rates, VAT 21/12/0 %, reverse charge, flat-rate expenses (80/60/40/30 %).
- Support: support@iucetni.com
